Lina (Marketing): Quick one  we have a joint benchmark blog with CloudPartner targeted Thu 08:00 PT (embargo). Need final asset pack + partner logo approvals. Can Omar run press?
Omar (PR): Yep. I'll coordinate CloudPartner outreach and run the embargo list. Who's the spokes for tech questions?
Ravi (Eng): I'll take technical Qs during the first 30m. Will upload perf PNG + CSV by EOD Wed.
Sam (CEO): I'll do a short partner quote and be on the 08:00-08:30 press calls.
Noelle (Legal): Partner logos need signed co-branding approval. Please send the joint embargo text for legal review. Avoid comparative claims without partner consent.
June (Comms): I'll prepare social copy and a co-branded assets pack. Need final logo files from CloudPartner.
Lina (Marketing): Noted. Lina to send assets checklist to CloudPartner and request logo by Tue EOD. Also scheduling a 07:40 PT pre-brief for spokes.
press-bot: Publish job queued for 2098765432. Reminder set. :robot_face:
Omar (PR): Draft call roster: Sam 08:00-08:20, Ravi 08:00-08:30, CloudPartner PM 08:10-08:30. I'll send invites after legal clears embargo.
Noelle (Legal): Received embargo draft. Minor edits made. Re-send final copy for sign-off after logo approvals.
June (Comms): Ops note for eng-oncall: potential traffic spike after syndication; route to dedicated canary for first 5 min. Lina please add to blog header.
Lina (Marketing): Added ops blurb. Checklist: 1) Final blog + PNG/CSV by Wed EOD, 2) Partner logo & approval, 3) Embargo signed, 4) 07:40 PT pre-brief, 5) Phone standby 08:00-09:00 PT.
Ravi (Eng): Uploaded PNG & CSV to shared drive. Run snippet: ```bash
run_bench --model=rwd-collab --seq=512 --batch=4
```
Omar (PR): I'll hold social until both partners confirm. If any reporter reaches out early, route to me.
Sam (CEO): Thanks team. Keep pre-brief under 15 min.
Lina (Marketing): Will post update when logos land. :rocket:
